Black—Victini and Reshiram| enva=Leah Clark| java=Satomi Ishihara| }} '''Carlita''' (Japanese: '''カリータ''' ''Karita'') is a character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. She is the daughter of [[Juanita]] and her older brother is [[Damon]]. Carlita is also a descendant of the People of the Vale. ==In the movies== Carlita participated in the [[Eindoak Harvest Festival]] battle tournament in [[Eindoak Town]]. She defeated [[Cilan's Pansage]] but lost to {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Scraggy}}, which received a power boost thanks to {{OBP|Victini|M14}}. Seeing that Victini was following Ash, Carlita explains to Ash that Victini is the Victory Pokémon and said to have mysterious powers. She accompanies Ash and {{ashfr}} throughout town, showing them around and visiting [[Mannes]] farm estate where Victini comes out of hiding and plays with everyone. the [[Sword of the Vale]]. Soon, her older brother [[Damon]] has returned home and announces that he is ready to put his plan into motion - restore the [[Kingdom of the Vale]] to its former glory. With the assistance of Victini's powers, the Eindoak Castle, also known as the [[Sword of the Vale]], is transformed into an ancient mechanism once again and begins to fly to its new location. Juanita and Carlita are horrified by Damon's actions, seeing that his desire is in fact hurting Victini. They work with Ash, his friends and Mannes to stop Damon and protect Victini. Later, Carlita helped battle her brother, using Hydreigon to help {{an|Iris}} escape from the Sword of the Vale. Carlita efforts alongside the others help stop the destruction of the released [[Dragon Force]] energy, Victini is safe and Sword of the Vale lands in a new location. Later, Carlita and the other People of the Vale are helping to re-establish and replenish the land that will become the new Kingdom of the Vale. ===Character=== Carlita is quick-witted and fiery in battle. She is otherwise kind and well-versed in her People of the Vale heritage. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Carlita |pkmn=Hydreigon |shiny=yes |type1=Dark |type2=Dragon |img=Carlita Hydreigon Black.png |img2=Carlita Hydreigon White.png |epnum=M14 |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom
Black—Victini and Reshiram |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc=Carlita used her Hydreigon in her battle against [[Cilan's Pansage]] in the Harvest Battle Tournament. It managed to defeat him with one powerful Dragon Breath. Upon seeing how powerful [[Ash's Tepig]] had performed in the [[Eindoak Town]] Harvest Festival Tournament, Carlita suspected that Tepig had been unknowingly powered up by {{p|Victini}} and requested a battle against him. Ash agreed, and used {{AP|Scraggy}} to battle Carlita's {{p|Hydreigon}}. Although Hydreigon should have easily outmatched Scraggy due to the fact he was relatively young and inexperienced, another power-up by Victini allowed Scraggy to defeat Hydreigon with a single {{m|Headbutt}}. Carlita later used Hydreigon to help her and {{an|Iris}} (who had admired Hydreigon due to it being a {{type|Dragon}}) escape the collapsing castle. In ''Victini and Zekrom'', Hydreigon is {{Shiny}}. In ''Victini and Reshiram'', it is normal colored. Hydreigon's only known move is {{m|Dragon Breath}}.}} ===Pokémon competitions=== Carlita has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Eindoak Harvest Festival|Eindoak Harvest Festival Battle Competition]] - {{tt|Unknown|Won 1 amulet}} (''[[M14|Pokémon the Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom, Black—Victini and Reshiram]]'') ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{dragon color}}; background: #{{dark color}}" | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{dragon color light}}; background: #{{dark color light}}; width:140px; height:140px"| [[File:Sugimori Carlita anime.png|200px]] |- | [[Ken Sugimori]]'s design of Carlita |} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{dark color light}}|bordercolor={{dragon color}} |ja=石原さとみ ''Satomi Ishihara'' |en=Leah Clark |it=Ludovica De Caro |da=Annevig Schelde Ebbe |fi=Taru Tikkanen |ko=안영미 ''An Yeongmi'' |no=Emilie Christensen |es_eu=Cristina Yuste |es_la=Monserrat Mendoza |pt_br=Tarsila Amorim |pl=Julia Chatys}} ==In the manga== [[File:Carlita M14 manga.png|thumb|150px|Carlita in the manga]] Carlita first appears after Ash has beaten all Trainers except her in the Eindoak Town Harvest Festival Tournament. She asks Ash if he wants to battle her which Ash agrees. Later, she helps out the protagonists in stopping Damon from controlling the Castle of the Vale. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |width=80 |trainer=Carlita |pkmn=Hydreigon |type1=Dark |type2=Dragon |img=Carlita Hydreigon M14 manga.png |epnum=White—Victini and Zekrom (manga) |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom |desc={{p|Hydreigon}} was Carlita's choice in the Eindoak Town Harvest Festival Tournament. It went up against [[Ash's Scraggy]] and was proven to be stronger as it was a fully evolved Pokémon. However, Hydreigon was subdued by Scraggy's {{m|Headbutt}} after Scraggy got a power up from Victini. Hydreigon's only known move is {{m|Dragon Pulse}}.}} ==In the games== A {{p|Hydreigon}} based on Carlita's {{Shiny}} Hydreigon was distributed to the Japanese players of {{game|Black and White|s|Pokémon Black}} at [[Nintendo Zone]]s in Japan starting on June 17, 2011. The Shiny Hydreigon was later distributed over Wi-Fi starting on July 8, 2011. Both the Nintendo Zone and the Wi-Fi distributions ended on September 8, 2011.
